en.home_tag: Know the market. Choose wisely. Earn more.
en.home_lead: Isoko Smart AI shows a farmer which market pays the most for a crop after the cost of getting there, and gives government a clear view of how prices move across Rwanda. Every price comes from real farmgate reports by Esoko Rwanda.
en.home_problem: Two markets a short ride apart can pay very different prices for the same beans or rice. Farmers rarely see those prices before they travel, and planners have no single, simple picture of where prices are low or moving fast.
en.home_example_title: A live example from today's data
en.home_example_intro: A farmer at {origin} with {qty} kg of {product} asks where to sell:
en.home_for_farmer: Pick your crop, how many kilos you have and where you are. You get one clear answer: where to sell, how much more you could earn after transport, and why. Works in English and Kinyarwanda, and by SMS on any phone.
en.home_for_gov: See every crop's price month by month, the gap between the cheapest and dearest markets, which markets report too little, and how far the data can be trusted. Download the tables for your own reports.
en.home_step1: 1. Collect: real farmgate prices from Esoko Rwanda, from 1 May 2026, in RWF per kg.
en.home_step2: 2. Calculate: price minus the cost of transport to each market, using real road distances where known.
en.home_step3: 3. Explain: a plain answer, the reasons, and a warning when the data is thin or the answer is not safe.
en.home_honest: The advice is a transparent calculation, so a farmer can always see why. Trained models are tested against simple rules and used only when they clearly win; today they do not, so they are not used. A language model only reads a farmer's message, it never chooses a market or writes a price.

rw.home_lead: Isoko Smart AI yereka umuhinzi isoko ryishyura byinshi igihingwa cye nyuma yo kwishyura ubwikorezi, ikanereka Leta uko ibiciro bihinduka mu Rwanda hose. Ibiciro byose bituruka ku makuru nyayo ya Esoko Rwanda.
rw.home_problem: Amasoko abiri ari hafi ashobora kwishyura ibiciro bitandukanye cyane ku bishyimbo cyangwa umuceri bimwe. Abahinzi ntibakunze kubona ibyo biciro mbere yo gutega, kandi abategura gahunda nta shusho imwe yoroshye bafite y'aho ibiciro biri hasi cyangwa bihinduka vuba.
rw.home_example_title: Urugero rufatiye ku makuru y'uyu munsi
rw.home_example_intro: Umuhinzi uri i {origin} ufite ibiro {qty} bya {product} arabaza aho yagurishiriza:
rw.home_for_farmer: Hitamo igihingwa, ibiro ufite n'aho uri. Ubona igisubizo kimwe gisobanutse: aho kugurisha, amafaranga yiyongera nyuma y'ubwikorezi, n'impamvu. Bikora mu Kinyarwanda no mu Cyongereza, no kuri SMS ku telefone iyo ari yo yose.
rw.home_for_gov: Reba ibiciro by'igihingwa cyose ukwezi ku kwezi, itandukaniro riri hagati y'amasoko ahendutse n'ahenze, amasoko atatanga amakuru ahagije, n'uko amakuru yizerwa. Manura imbonerahamwe ukoreshe muri raporo zawe.
rw.home_step1: 1. Gukusanya: ibiciro nyabyo byo ku muhanda bya Esoko Rwanda, guhera ku itariki ya 1 Gicurasi 2026, mu mafaranga y'u Rwanda ku kilo.
rw.home_step2: 2. Kubara: igiciro gisigaye nyuma yo gukuramo ubwikorezi bugana ku isoko ryose, hakoreshejwe intera nyayo y'umuhanda aho izwi.
rw.home_step3: 3. Gusobanura: igisubizo cyoroshye, impamvu, n'umuburo iyo amakuru ari make cyangwa igisubizo kitizewe.
rw.home_honest: Inama itangwa ni ukubara kugaragara, bityo umuhinzi ahora abona impamvu. Moderi zatojwe zipimwa ugereranyije n'amategeko yoroshye kandi zikoreshwa gusa iyo zitsinze neza; uyu munsi ntizitsinda, ntizikoreshwa. Moderi y'ururimi isoma ubutumwa bw'umuhinzi gusa, ntihitamo isoko cyangwa ngo yandike igiciro.
rw.home_pick: Hitamo urubuga ku ruhande rw'ibumoso, cyangwa ukande akabuto hejuru.
